name: Net Mania ~Harimegurasareta Kousha~
original_name: ネットマニア ～張り巡らされた校舎～
source:
A student at a tech school spends most of his time online.
He’s never really talked to girls his age, and with graduation just a month away, he comes up with a plan.
He uses the school’s network to find private information. He shares it to break up couples.
When chaos starts, he steps in.
A story about manipulation and rape.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020611093139/http://www.interheart.jp/interheart/netmania/netmania.htm]the official website[/url]]
